title: Automate GitHub ruleset sync as IaC
description: Add ruleset desired-state file and workflow to check drift on PR/feature branches and apply on main or manual dispatch using RULESET_ADMIN_TOKEN.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implemented ruleset IaC bootstrap: added desired-state file `infra/github-rulesets/main-branch-protection.json`, added sync utility `scripts/sync-rulesets.sh` (check/apply modes), and added dedicated workflow `.github/workflows/ruleset-sync.yml`. Workflow runs on feature/* and PRs in check mode, applies on push to main, and supports manual workflow_dispatch check/apply. Verified locally: script check reports ruleset in sync and workflow YAML validates.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Enhanced ruleset IaC sync to avoid hardcoded IDs: `scripts/sync-rulesets.sh` now resolves rulesets by desired `name` + `target`, updates when found, and creates missing rulesets in apply mode. Desired-state JSON no longer requires `id` (removed from `infra/github-rulesets/main-branch-protection.json`). Verified: `./scripts/sync-rulesets.sh check` reports in sync.
